title: Doubly periodic functions
summary: Functions with two R-independent periods live on a torus C/Λ for lattice Λ. Nonconstant elliptic functions must have poles (Liouville-type constraints).

title: Weierstrass ℘
summary: ℘(z;Λ)=1/z²+∑_{ω≠0}(1/(z−ω)²−1/ω²) is the fundamental even elliptic function with double poles on Λ; satisfies algebraic differential equation leading to cubic relation with invariants g₂,g₃.
